full_list.title_zh: 纠正人工智能生成的虚假刑事指控：补救性结案的人权框架
full_list.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can fabricate criminal allegations about identifiable people, but the legal difficulty is not confined to correcting the visible output. A false claim may persist in service-side memory, retrieval systems, application programming interface transmissions, risk fields and downstream institutional decisions. Existing scholarship on data rectification, AI supply chains, algorithmic contestability and model correction addresses parts of this problem but does not provide a unified legal test for when distributed remediation is complete. This article develops a propagation-aware standard of remedial closure: a structured test for determining when corrective action has been completed across relevant stages of an AI system. It combines doctrinal analysis of international and regional human-rights law, European Union data-protection law and business-and-human-rights standards with technical literature on memory, retrieval, model editing and unlearning. China’s Personal Information Protection Law is used as a limited comparative portability test, and a publicly documented complaint concerning an AI-generated false criminal allegation provides a case-informed scenario. The framework requires five functions: accessible challenge and reasoned determination; cessation at reasonably identifiable nodes; correction of inaccurate records and reassessment of materially affected decisions where applicable law permits or requires; verifiable implementation; and proportionate non-recurrence safeguards. Responsibility remains actor- and operation-specific, and tracing may cease where further inquiry is objectively impossible or disproportionate considering severity and expected remedial value. Rectification is treated as legally complete only when the responsible actor can provide reasonable, demonstrable assurance that the verified false allegation has been corrected or contained across reasonably identifiable, materially relevant processing nodes within its authority, with applicable downstream effects addressed and residual risks documented.

core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《A-Site Engineering Aurivilius Bi4Ti3O12 用于增强铁电极化和光催化整体水分解》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
